scene: The woven tapestry reveals secret transit portals waiting beyond the lobby wall.
picture: A flat side view of the lobby's back concourse. On the far left, a gleaming gold escalator ascends upward under bright arrows. The player stands facing right in red bomber jacket and roller skates. In the centre, a bowl-shaped noodle-cart monorail sits docked. On the far right, a green bamboo cable car waits open.
shown: A neon arrow pointing up a gold rooftop escalator on the far left.
